# M4.1 marker detection measurements

**All numbers are from synthetic images, not real cameras.** Generated by `npm run measure:detection` (`scripts/measure-detection.ts`);
conditions are in `src/optical/testing/detect-conditions.ts` and are the same ones `src/optical/detect.test.ts` asserts on.
Output is deterministic (seed 20251112, no timestamps or runtimes). Detector defaults: Otsu binarization, minSizePx 14.

## Summary

| Quantity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| DETECTED results with wrong bits (all families, required conditions) | 0 |
| False positives on negative images | 0 of 320 |
| Min exact module size, crisp integer renders (all 52 patterns, all larger sizes up to 24 also exact) | 2 px per module (7x7 edge 14 px) |
| Min exact module size, blurred fractional scales (52 patterns) | 2.5 px per module (7x7 edge 17.5 px) |
| Perspective: highest tilt with 100% exact reads (camera 5 marker edges away) | 50 degrees |
| Perspective: highest tilt with 100% exact reads (camera 3 marker edges away) | 50 degrees |

Notes: "exact" means exactly one marker (or the expected markers for card layers / sheet) with the expected bits, at the expected location where checked.

## Rotation (every 5 degrees, 10 patterns, modulePx 8)

720 of 720 cases exact. Away from the +-45 degree canonical boundaries the bits equal R90^k . P with k = round(theta/90) mod 4 (clockwise degrees); the analytic expectation was **not contradicted**.
At the boundary angles (45, 135, 225, 315 degrees) any of the four R90 rotations is accepted; strict cases 680 of 680 exact.

Solid black 7x7-module square with white margin: `DETECTED[n=1 bits=33554431]` (bits 33554431 = 0x1FFFFFF). Structurally a valid ring with all-ones data; the detector has no template knowledge and reports it. Rejection belongs to template matching (task 4.2).

## Remaining limitations

- Synthetic rasters only. Real printing, paper gloss, lens distortion, motion blur, rolling shutter and colour are untested.
- Illumination: see the degradation table. Global Otsu fails on strong ramps; the adaptive mode has a fixed window and offset and was only tried on linear ramps.
- Occluded or damaged borders are rejected, never repaired. Damaged data cells are read as they appear.
- Markers closer than the 1-module margin to other dark structure merge into one component and are rejected.
- Several markers per image are detected independently. Grouping into a 2x2 corner cluster (design 7.2) is not implemented here.
